name: Mi Tao
source:
Mi Tao is a stripper. Her childhood memories are vague and before she knew it, she ended up in the slums. There, she met Ryou, who's around the same age as her and their fates intertwined. Mi Tao is a very good dancer and when her body is pushed to its limits during rigorous dancing, she enters a peculiar trance. She often hums a tune even she herself has no idea where it comes from, though it's Ryou's lullaby. She loves Ryou and is the type to devote herself to her boyfriend.

[Translation of [url=https://succulent01.wixsite.com/huyoudo]official website profile[/url].]
